ar.title: سلطة البيواظ اللبنانية
ar.intro: فرك البصل بالملح والسماق يكسر حدته ويجعله طرياً حامضاً، وهو الرفيق الأول لمشويات المطاعم اللبنانية.

steps.n1: يُفرك البصل الشرائح بالملح والسماق بالأصابع دقيقة حتى يلين ويتلون بالأرجواني.
steps.n3: يُرش بزيت الزيتون والليمون إن رغبت، ويُقدم فوراً مع المشويات والكفتة والشاورما.

en.title: Lebanese Bayaz (Onion, Parsley and Sumac Salad)
en.intro: Rubbing the onion with salt and sumac takes away its sharpness and makes it soft and tangy; it is the classic partner of grills in Lebanese restaurants.

steps.n1: Rub the sliced onion with the salt and sumac between your fingers for a minute until it softens and turns purple.
steps.n3: Drizzle with olive oil and lemon if you like and serve at once with grills, kofta and shawarma.

legacySteps: Rub the sliced onion with the salt and sumac between your fingers for a minute until it softens and turns purple.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon if you like and serve at once with grills, kofta and shawarma.
